title: Creating a Kill Switch to Shut Down a Rogue A.I. Is Harder Than It Sounds
summary: A bipartisan group in Congress and Gov. Gavin Newsom of California have floated ideas for building a mechanism that would instantly power down an A.I. system. Only no one really knows how.
